allowedHosts.title: Allowed vCenter hosts
allowedHosts.description: Hostnames where TypeThru may send text, e.g. vcenter.example.com or *.example.com. When set, users cannot change the list. Empty or unset: every host is allowed (users can set their own list).

defaultLayout.title: Default guest keyboard layout
defaultLayout.description: Layout preselected until the user chooses one: us, de, de-ch, fr, uk, es, it.
